In the reference model, torch.maximum with a float scalar promotes the integer one-hot tensor to float32. Our custom sequence does not perform this promotion, causing the dtype check in maximum_scalar_forward to fail. The fix is to make one_hot_forward return a float32 tensor (or cast the result before maximum_scalar_forward), matching the reference dtype at step_002.
